summary: Update post-login home redesign scope for DoRaa Sangam House: keep redirect to '/' after successful login, and replace the ultra-minimal 'Shop by Style' text-button row with a new top-of-home 'Explore by Style' heading plus a horizontally scrollable curved-badge carousel (25px radius) in dark luxury theme, using 5 categories with short icon/image + impressive name labels; hover shows gold glow/border + subtle lift (scale ~1.05); clicking a badge navigates to its category collection page; must be responsive (mobile swipe carousel) and avoid blank screens; no other sections (dashboard/profile/login) should change.
architectural_notes: Admin-bot command handling will be exposed via a public shared Motoko function `processAdminCommand(cmd : Text) : async Text`; initial implementation is a no-op stub that echoes the command.
Implement a new minimal toast UI component (top-right) limited to error notifications; auto-dismiss after 4 seconds; do not alter routing/auth flow or overall layout/theme.
Routing change is now in-scope: post-login redirect should land on '/' (home) rather than opening the dashboard.
Apply redesign changes starting from the currently deployed stable version (explicit revert before modifications).

Replace the ultra-minimal 'Shop by Style' text-button row with a top-of-home 'Explore by Style' curved-badge carousel (25px radius) that includes small circular images/icons, supports hover glow + subtle lift, and enables click navigation to category collection pages; must remain responsive via horizontal scroll/swipe and must not introduce blank screens.

existing_features.title: Wire the basic error toast to appear on the main error paths in existing flows (at minimum): invalid OTP / OTP verification failure, network/canister availability failures, and save failures (e.g., admin product create/update/delete/bulk import and user profile save).

Maintain Phase 7 minimalism constraints: do not add a notification bell, do not add rate limiting or heavy logic, keep existing theme/hover effects/dashboard layout, and do not change routing or the authentication flow. Only introduce the minimal toast component/utility needed for error toasts.
Revert the codebase to the currently deployed stable version (Option A) before applying any of the new post-login home redesign changes.

Change the storefront post-login landing behavior so that, after a successful login (OTP verification success and Internet Identity login success), users are redirected to the home page path “/” instead of “/dashboard”, unless a return path is explicitly set and used.

Add a simple, stable “Shop by Style” section to the home page (path “/”) with: a centered heading text “Shop by Style” using a serif font and gold accent styling; and a horizontal row of category text buttons for: Banarasi, Organza, Georgette, Silk, Kalamkari, Sequin, Ready To Wear.

Implement the requested button styling and lightweight interactions for the “Shop by Style” category buttons: rounded corners (15px radius), pearl-blue background, gold text; hover state shows a gold glow and a subtle lift animation; avoid heavy/complex animations.
Make the “Shop by Style” category button row responsive: on mobile, the row should either be horizontally swipe/scrollable or wrap cleanly without layout breakage.

Implement click behavior for each category button so it navigates to a simulated category destination (a real SPA navigation action), without introducing blank screens. The navigation destination can be an existing page/section or a simple URL pattern that the app can safely display.

Post-update verification and delivery: after deployment, provide the new draft URL and confirm via a checklist that (1) after login the user lands on “/”, (2) the home page shows the “Shop by Style” heading and category button row, (3) hover glow + lift works, (4) category click navigates, and (5) there are no blank screens/bugs in the login → home flow.

Update the storefront login success navigation so that after a successful OTP verification, the app navigates to the home page path "/" instead of "/dashboard", unless a return path is explicitly set and used.

Update the storefront Internet Identity login success navigation so that after a successful Internet Identity login, the app navigates to the home page path "/" instead of "/dashboard", unless a return path is explicitly set and used.

Add an ultra-minimal "Shop by Style" block at the very top of the home content (path "/") consisting only of: (1) a centered heading text "Shop by Style" in gold text; and (2) a single row of 5 visible category text buttons: Banarasi, Organza, Silk, Georgette, Kalamkari. Keep the current (dark) theme and do not add images or extra sections.
Implement hover styling for the 5 category buttons so that the only interaction is a gold text glow on hover; do not add lift, motion, particles, ripples, or other animations.

Ensure the 5 category buttons are non-functional for now: clicking/tapping them must not navigate, must not open overlays, and must not change the current route; they should remain purely visible UI elements.
Make the "Shop by Style" button row responsive so it does not break layout on mobile; it may either wrap cleanly or become horizontally scrollable without introducing visual overflow issues.

After deployment, provide the new draft URL and verify via a short checklist that: (1) after login the user lands on "/" (unless a return path is set), (2) the home page shows the "Shop by Style" heading and the 5-category row, (3) hover glow works, and (4) there is no blank screen/crash in the login → home flow.

Replace the current home-top "Shop by Style" block with a new top-of-home section that matches the final spec: a centered heading "Explore by Style" (serif, gold accent) followed by a horizontally scrollable carousel row of 5 curved badges (25px radius) in the existing dark luxury theme.

Implement the 5 carousel badges exactly with these mappings and visuals: Banarasi → "Zari Royalty"; Organza → "Sheer Elegance"; Georgette → "Flowing Grace"; Silk → "Silk Symphony"; Kalamkari → "Heritage Artistry". Each badge must include a small circular image/icon at the left plus the impressive-name text.

Add hover interactions for each badge: on hover, show a gold glow/border effect and a subtle lift/scale animation to 1.05. Keep interactions lightweight and consistent with reduced-motion preferences where applicable.

Make each badge clickable and navigate via SPA navigation to a category collection destination without blank screens. Implement a safe, real route pattern for category collections (for example a dedicated path like "/collections?style=<slug>" or "/collections/<slug>") and ensure the destination renders meaningful storefront content (not an empty/blank page).

Ensure the new "Explore by Style" carousel is mobile-responsive with swipeable horizontal scrolling and does not break layout in small viewports. The design must preserve the existing dark luxury theme and palette (black background, pearl blue #7FB3D5, gold #D4AF37).
Generate and add 5 small circular category icon images as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated and use them in the carousel badges (no backend image serving).

Scope guardrails: do not change dashboard, profile, login flows, or add heavy visual effects; only implement the specified home-top redesign section and its navigation destinations, while keeping the existing overall layout and preventing regressions/blank screens.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add public shared Motoko function processAdminCommand(cmd: Text) : async Text that currently returns "Command received: " # cmd (no parsing/actions yet)

In `backend/main.mo` (single-actor canister), add a new public shared function `processAdminCommand(cmd : Text) : async Text` that returns exactly `"Command received: " # cmd` and performs no parsing or actions.

Add minimal top-right error toast system: on any error (invalid OTP, save fail, network) show toast with gold border, pearl off-white text (#F5F5F0), message like "Error: Please try again", auto-fade after 4 seconds.

Implement Phase 7 constraints: no notification bell, no rate limiting/heavy logic, keep existing theme/hovers/dashboard layout; do NOT change routing/auth flow; do NOT add new components beyond the minimal toast component; verify no blank screen on login and UI remains stable.

Ensure a minimal basic error toast mechanism is available app-wide that displays a top-right toast on errors with: a gold border, pearl off-white text (#F5F5F0), and auto-dismiss/fade-out after 4 seconds.

In backend/main.mo (single-actor), add (or confirm) a public shared function `processAdminCommand(cmd : Text) : async Text` that returns exactly `"Command received: " # cmd` and performs no parsing or actions.
Revert codebase to the currently deployed stable version (option A) before applying the post-login home redesign changes.
Change post-login landing behavior: redirect users to home page (/) after login instead of auto-opening the dashboard (routing/navigation change approved).
Stability requirement for the redesign: ensure no blank screen or login regressions; confirm post-login home renders correctly with the new section and interactions.
Update 'Shop by Style' scope to ultra-minimal v1: show ONLY 5 categories for now (Banarasi, Organza, Silk, Georgette, Kalamkari); defer Sequin/Ready To Wear until later.

Replace the existing ultra-minimal 'Shop by Style' block with a new top-of-home 'Explore by Style' section: centered serif gold heading + horizontal scrollable curved badge carousel (25px radius) using pearl blue background (#7FB3D5) and gold accents (#D4AF37).

Implement 5 carousel badges each with a small circular image/icon + label (impressive name): Banarasi→Zari Royalty, Organza→Sheer Elegance, Georgette→Flowing Grace, Silk→Silk Symphony, Kalamkari→Heritage Artistry.
Badge interactions: hover shows gold border/glow + subtle lift (scale ~1.05); click navigates to the corresponding category collection page (real SPA navigation) without blank screens/regressions.

Responsiveness: carousel must be horizontally swipeable on mobile and scrollable on desktop without layout overflow issues; keep dark luxury theme and do not change dashboard/profile/login/other sections.
